
This is a preliminary assessment. Sampling effort is uneven across the region and the records have gaps, but it
offers a starting point for tracking how well the region's plant diversity is protected. You can help improve it by
sharing your observations with the
[Átl’ḵa7tsem/Howe Sound Biosphere Region iNaturalist project](https://www.inaturalist.org/projects/atl-ka7tsem-howe-sound-biosphere-region).

The map shows protected and conserved areas by category. Click an area on the map or in the chart to see the plants
recorded there, or a category in the legend or the chart to see those recorded across all its areas. Key Biodiversity Areas are
outlined in cream. Choose
*Unprotected native plant diversity* to see where the native plants not yet found in any protected area have been
recorded.

Protected areas are from the [Canadian Protected and Conserved Areas Database](https://www.canada.ca/en/environment-climate-change/services/national-wildlife-areas/protected-conserved-areas-database.html)
(Environment and Climate Change Canada), and Key Biodiversity Areas from [KBA Canada](https://kbacanada.org/)
(CC BY-NC-SA 4.0).
